<function name="GetExtentInfo" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns size info about the nav area.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">Returns a table containing the following keys:
* <page>Vector</page> hi - "Maxs" of the nav area in world space
* <page>Vector</page> lo - "Mins" of the nav area in world space
* <page>number</page> SizeX - Size on the X axis
* <page>number</page> SizeY - Size on the Y axis
* <page>number</page> SizeZ - Size of the Z axis
</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
